description: This file declares TypeScript modules and classes for the Microsoft Teams SDK, providing type definitions for interacting with Teams applications, clients, and JWT validation middleware.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams application with methods to obtain bot and app graph tokens.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams API client for managing conversations and activities.

classes.name: JwtValidator
classes.description: Performs JWT validation for Microsoft Teams authentication tokens.

methods.name: getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the application graph token.

methods.name: constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string }); constructor
methods.description: Initializes the classes with required options.

methods.name: validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates an access token, returning the token details or null.

methods.name: createServiceTokenValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator function for service tokens based on app ID and tenant ID.

ctags.name: constructor
ctags.pattern: /^    constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string });$/
